rule: lowest system score; among designs within 0.25 of it, the cheapest
hf_note: HF changed from the ND1030 to the B&C DE111 after FEM: 60 mm body instead of 65 (bullet 66 mm against 72), rated from 1.2 kHz instead of 1.8 kHz, and cheaper. Mid compression re-picked on FEM: 2.0. The mid top end is set by the cone depth: -6 dB at about 3.3 kHz either way.
crossover_note: The network model alone picks a higher crossover. The FEM shows the mid falling 8 to 12 dB from 3 to 6 kHz (a radial cavity mode over the cone that the network lumps away), so f2 is re-picked with that correction: the highest of 2.5 to 4 kHz scoring within 0.15 of the best.
